about: Beings from another age are causing havoc across the land! And with their mischief comes a great threat to everyone.

The unlikeliest hero, a golem born of bread, will find himself and his newfound buddies in the middle of a drama that's thousands of years in the making. Together, they will visit incredible locals and meet fascinating characters.
Although he may not look like much, Loaf might be the hero this land kneads.
summary: Born of Bread is a wacky and joyful RPG, revisiting turn-based combat tropes.
